Acceptance evidence: Compare physical parts with signed BOM and pinout

Action: Gauge enclosure, bezel, pocket and pivot
Acceptance evidence: Free reel movement, no cell or display compression

Action: Mate JST plugs; document keyed polarity and continuity
Acceptance evidence: Independent polarity verification before connecting battery

Action: Install rotor, sensor, cell, speaker and optional motor per Rev E fit sequence
Acceptance evidence: No trapped wire; stable angle reading through a full revolution

Action: Record firmware digest and provision public verification key / feed
Acceptance evidence: USB boot and signed update check

Action: Exercise cast, lift, direction, touch, audio, rumble, Wi-Fi and RTC
Acceptance evidence: Record live readings and clock holdover result

Action: Check serial, market label, release version and packout
Log A1 SKU 31137 and PCB revision. Confirm the original capacitive glass and touch response before fitting the bezel.
Acceptance evidence: Supplier marking and nine accepted points in the firmware touch grid

Action: Verify K3 nets unpowered. Fit SW1 on PCB1 and strain-relieve W3. Cycle the key with the retainer secured.
Acceptance evidence: Open at rest and momentary closure; inspect solder joints and insulation

Action: Install Rev F cap and retainer. Attach and release G1. Cycle the folding crank and inspect glass and all controls in both configurations.
Result: locked screw retention and proof-test results per the Rev F grip procedure

Action: On battery operate the top-left key. Repeat touch grid with case closed and USB connected. Exercise reel click and all three fish effects with the motor fitted.
Acceptance evidence: Signed unit record with 9/9 touch points and recorded power and rumble results

Action: Record firmware hash and component lot. Release after applicable Rev E checks and Rev F test results are reviewed.
Record the enclosure and electrical packages selected. Match the three changed prints and nine carry-forward parts to the revision register.
Acceptance evidence: Verified print digests, slicer profile, material lot and printed gauge dimensions

Action: Install the west key retainer. Seat and remove both inert gauges with dummy leads. Fit the bridge and close the case per the Rev G procedure.
Acceptance evidence: Record gauge IDs, witness marks, bridge clearance, key travel and lead dressing

Action: Record actual hardware and firmware independently by serial. Attach results and all open fit, electrical and supplier gates before any decision on powered closure.
Acceptance evidence: Signed sample disposition with revision IDs, evidence, deviations and retest

Action: Match all twelve supplied part hashes to the R0008 register. Keep supplied orientations and apply part-specific brims.
Acceptance evidence: Record filament lot, slicer profile, individual brim widths and printed gauge dimensions.

Action: Remove localized shell support at the grip receiver, sensor lands, reel well, key and tunnel. Clear the rotor rim and recess.
Acceptance evidence: Inspect under magnification and retain photographs of bearing faces, hinge eye and guide surfaces.

Action: Fit and remove both inert packs and harnesses. Seat bridge and bezel, check key travel, nine touch targets, full reel turn and crank fold.
Acceptance evidence: Record lead dressing and clearances, key return, actual touch test with an external supply when approved, smooth motion and connector access.

Action: Verify rod insertion, captive screw retraction, travel stop, play and cast-load durability. Record first-article and electrical disposition.
Acceptance evidence: Physical print and fit signed off before powered pack closure. Record actual firmware, serials, lots, deviations and retest.
